settings.heading: TWO EXPRESSIONS OF PRESENCE.
settings.subtext: Four foundational 20% Eau de Parfum signatures for daily proximity, paired with two limited-batch 30% Extrait Reserve releases devoted to resin, root, and stillness.
settings.archive_copy: Four foundational compositions shaped by daylight clarity, mineral iris, crushed fig leaf, dry hinoki, and green cardamom. Available in 50 ml and 100 ml.
settings.reserve_copy: High-concentration Extrait de Parfum releases devoted to Omani frankincense, smoked birch, and aged Florentine orris. Smoked 50 ml glass — 50 numbered flacons each.
